name: Recover abandoned Shopify checkouts with Llama 3.2, Gmail, and Sheets

nodes.name: On Shopify checkout or order event

parameters.content:
### How it works
Shopify webhooks (checkout creation, checkout update, order creation) feed one entry point. Checkouts are deduplicated by cart token, since Shopify can issue a new checkout token mid-session on the same cart. After 1 hour without a purchase, an AI model writes a personalized reminder using the exact product and price. Another 24 hours later it sends a 10% discount email, and 24 hours after that a final urgency email. Before each email the workflow re-checks whether the customer already bought, and stops if so. When an order completes, the checkout is marked Recovered and a thank-you email with an upsell suggestion goes out. Everything is logged to Google Sheets, and a weekly report emails the store owner the recovered revenue.

### Setup
1. In Shopify (Settings → Notifications → Webhooks), add three webhooks pointing to this workflow's Production URL: Checkout creation, Checkout update, and Order creation. Use API version 2026-07, not unstable.
2. Create a Google Sheet with these headers: Checkout Token, Email, Product, Price, Status, Recovery Link, Created At, Last Updated.
3. Create a 10% discount code named CART10 in Shopify.
4. Connect your Google Sheets and Gmail credentials, and select your Sheet in every Sheets node.
5. Point each HTTP Request node at your own Ollama, GPT-4o, or Claude endpoint.
6. Set the Weekly Summary email recipient to your own address, then publish.

### Customization
- Edit the product list in Pick Upsell and the store name in the Code nodes.
- Adjust the three Wait nodes, or change the discount code and email tone in the HTTP Request prompts.

## Checkout Logging & Reminder Sequence
Logs every checkout, then waits 1h → 24h → 24h, checking for a purchase before each AI email.

## Order Recovery & Upsell
Fires on order completion. Marks the checkout Recovered and sends an AI thank-you + upsell email.

## Weekly Report
Every Monday 9am: reads the tracker and emails the store owner recovered revenue and recovery rate.
